messages:
maria_cs: FYI — drafted a compact customer-facing HealthCard for onboarding & renewal signals. Focus: caching, batching, streaming best-practices + how those tie to renewal risk. Sharing preview shortly.

ops-bot: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.docs/drafts/healthcard-1781818181 (view-only, expires in 72h)

leo_solutions: skimming now, looks clean. Can we add a single-line mapping for AMs: signal -> immediate action? e.g., cache miss spike -> increase prefill concurrency + start outreach.

maria_cs: yep — will add a "If this happens / Do this" quick table and a short bullets for escalation steps. Also planning to add suggested prefill thresholds and a tiny eval prompt set for quality checks after quantization.

sam_eng: recommend we include a ready-to-copy prefill config so customers can apply quickly. put this under "Ops snippets".

sam_eng: ```yaml
prefill:
  enabled: true
  concurrency: 8
  max_prefill_tokens: 512
cache:
  ttl_seconds: 600
  eviction_policy: lru
batching:
  target_ms: 15
  max_batch_size: 32
```

nina_pm: add a very short go-live weekend checklist: who owns stream fallback, who watches token spend, which dashboard to check first. AMs always ask that.

maria_cs: done — added owner roles and a 6-step weekend checklist. Also added a renewal_risk heuristic: sustained 3x cache miss + 30% latency uplift over 72h => flag for outreach.

leo_solutions: +1. Can we also include sample alert rules and dashboard widget names so AMs can copy-paste into monitoring?

maria_cs: added an example alert: `avg_latency_p99 > 800 && cache_miss_rate > 0.25` sustained 6h => send to #cs-alerts and tag AM. Included dashboard widget names: "Tenant: Latency (P50/P95/P99)", "Tenant: Cache Miss Rate", "Prefill Throughput".

ops-bot: Document preview created: https://redwood.docs/preview/healthcard-1781818181 (expires in 72h)

nina_pm: can we schedule a short 20m walk-through with AMs tomorrow 10:30 PT? I'll send invites.

sam_eng: one more note for streaming clients: prefer client-side chunking for requests >1024 tokens to reduce server-side tail latency. Added a small diagram.

maria_cs: good call — included that under "Streaming best-practices" with an example and a fallback policy suggestion (server-side reassembly).

maria_cs: Anyone object to me publishing this as 'CS Quick HealthCard: Onboarding & Renewal Signals' by EOD? I want it customer-facing but intentionally compact.

leo_solutions: publish away. :rocket:

nina_pm: :thumbsup: I'll circulate to AMs and mention the walk-through.

maria_cs: thanks! tagging @ops-bot for final PDF export.

ops-bot: Export complete: S3://internal-docs/cs/healthcard-1781818181.pdf
